newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Konka shareholders approve dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Konka shareholders approve dividend plan.

text.p: Shareholders of Konka Group Co Ltd have approved a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.52 yuan per share based on 1996 net profits, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
The plan, proposed by the firm's board of directors, will require final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the statement, published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, said.
A company official said an ex-dividend date had yet to be fixed.

The exchange rate for the B share dividend would be based on the weighted average rate between the Chinese yuan and Hong Kong dollar one week before the ex-dividend date, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securties Bulletin.
The television maker posted net profits of 346 million yuan in 1996, up 29.1 percent against 268 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
